title: Umakhi Oqinile Wensindiso
intro: Njengomuntu onesineke esikhulu nokuqiniseka okungenakunyakaziswa, lo muntu wanikela iminyaka eminingi emsebenzini ongcwele, ebhekene nokudelelwa nokulahlwa okungapheli. Indaba yabo iwubufakazi obunamandla bokholo lapho ebhekene nokungakholwa okukhulu, okwaphetha ngesenzakalo esibalulekile esashintsha umhlaba.
clues: Nganikela isikhathi eside kakhulu empilweni yami ngibiza abantu bami ukuba bakhulekele u-Allah.
Abantu bami bangihleka usulu futhi bangisola ngokuthi ngiyiphutha elibonakalayo kanye nobuhlanya.
Ngayalwa ukuba ngakhe into eyayibonakala ingavamile emphakathini wami ovaliwe.
Bambalwa kuphela abakholwa futhi bahlanganyela nami nomndeni wami kulesi sakhiwo esiyingqayizivele.
Ngathwala ngazimbili zazo zonke izidalwa eziphilayo ebhodini, njengoba kwayala u-Allah.
Isikhukhula esikhulu sagubuzela umhlaba, sasindisa kuphela labo ababenami esitsheni sami, kanti indodana yami yabhubha ngenxa yokungakholwa kwayo.
arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
